cards.ex: He seems to have lost his moral compass; he's doing some questionable things.
cards.exUz: Uning axloqiy kompasini yo'qotganga o'xshaydi; u ba'zi shubhali ishlarni qilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: To'g'ri va noto'g'rini ajratishga yordam beradigan ichki tuyg'u.

cards.ex: I don't mind helping out, but I draw the line at doing your homework for you.
cards.exUz: Yordam berishga qarshi emasman, lekin sizning uy vazifangizni bajarishga chegara qo'yaman.

cards.ex: The deal seemed completely above board, so we went ahead with it.
cards.exUz: Kelishuv butunlay halol ko'rindi, shuning uchun biz davom etdik.

cards.ex: The company cut corners on safety to increase profits, which is unethical.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya foydani oshirish uchun xavfsizlikka zarar yetkazdi, bu axloqsizdir.
cards.uzDef: Xarajatlarni kamaytirish uchun sifatga zarar yetkazish.

cards.ex: It's not always easy, but we should always try to do the right thing.
cards.exUz: Bu har doim ham oson emas, lekin biz har doim to'g'ri ish qilishga harakat qilishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Axloqan to'g'ri deb hisoblangan narsani qilish.

cards.ex: Allowing him to skip one class is a slippery slope; soon he'll be skipping them all.
cards.exUz: Unga bitta dars qoldirishga ruxsat berish - bu sirpanchiq yo'l; tez orada u ularning hammasini qoldiradi.
cards.uzDef: Bitta noto'g'ri qaror boshqa yomon qarorlarga olib kelishi.

cards.ex: The manager turned a blind eye to the employee's misconduct.
cards.exUz: Menejer xodimning xatti-harakatlariga ko'z yumdi.

cards.ex: He struggled to live up to his father's high ethical standards.
cards.exUz: U otasining yuqori axloqiy standartlariga javob berishga qiynaldi.

cards.ex: He had to resign due to a conflict of interest.
cards.exUz: U manfaatlar to'qnashuvi tufayli iste'foga chiqishga majbur bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Shaxsiy manfaati vazifaga xalaqit beradigan vaziyat.

cards.ex: I have a clean conscience; I did nothing wrong.
cards.exUz: Mening vijdonim sof; men hech qanday yomon ish qilmadim.

cards.ex: She always tries to take the moral high ground in arguments.
cards.exUz: U har doim bahslarda axloqiy ustunlikni egallashga harakat qiladi.

cards.ex: The doctor faced an ethical dilemma about whether to prolong the patient's life.
cards.exUz: Shifokor bemorning hayotini uzaytirish yoki yo'qligi haqida axloqiy dilemma bilan yuzlashdi.

cards.ex: We negotiated the contract in good faith, believing they were honest.
cards.exUz: Biz shartnomani halol niyat bilan muzokara qildik, ularning halol ekanligiga ishonardik.

cards.ex: You can trust him; he's always on the level.
cards.exUz: Siz unga ishonishingiz mumkin; u har doim to'g'ri.

cards.ex: Don't lose sight of your values in the pursuit of success.
cards.exUz: Muvaffaqiyatga intilishda qadriyatlaringizni unutib qo'ymang.

cards.ex: We must protect the environment at all costs.
cards.exUz: Biz atrof-muhitni har qanday narxda himoya qilishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir qilish uchun har qanday qiyinchilikka tayyor bo'lish.

cards.ex: It's important to stand for something, even if it's unpopular.
cards.exUz: Mashhur bo'lmasa ham, nimadir uchun kurashish muhim.
cards.uzDef: Asosiy qadriyatlar yoki e'tiqodlarga ega bo'lish.

cards.ex: To his credit, he admitted he was wrong.
cards.exUz: Maqtashga arziydigan joyi shundaki, u xato qilganini tan oldi.

cards.ex: I didn't want to apologize, but I bit the bullet and did it.
cards.exUz: Men kechirim so'rashni xohlamadim, lekin chidadim va qildim.

cards.ex: He felt like he was living a lie, hiding his true feelings.
cards.exUz: U o'zining haqiqiy his-tuyg'ularini yashirib, yolg'on bilan yashayotgandek his qildi.

cards.ex: The company's business practices have been called into question due to their questionable ethics.
cards.exUz: Kompaniyaning biznes amaliyotlari shubhali axloqi tufayli shubha ostiga qo'yildi.

cards.ex: He always gets stuck doing the dirty work around the office.
cards.exUz: U har doim ofis atrofida kir ishni qilishga majbur bo'ladi.

cards.ex: We have a moral obligation to help those in need.
cards.exUz: Bizda yordamga muhtojlarga yordam berish axloqiy burchimiz bor.
cards.uzDef: Axloqiy printsip asosida bajarilishi kerak bo'lgan narsa.

cards.ex: He took the blame for his friend's mistake to protect him.
cards.exUz: U do'stini himoya qilish uchun uning xatosi uchun aybni o'z zimmasiga oldi.
cards.uzDef: Noto'g'ri bo'lsa ham, xato uchun javobgarlikni o'z zimmasiga olish.

cards.ex: Just play fair and let the best person win.
cards.exUz: Faqat halol o'ynang va eng yaxshi odam g'alaba qozonsin.
cards.uzDef: Qoidalarga rioya qilish va adolatli harakat qilish.

cards.ex: He was accused of bending the truth to make himself look better.
cards.exUz: U o'zini yaxshiroq ko'rsatish uchun haqiqatni buzishda ayblangan.

cards.ex: I refuse to support that law on principle.
cards.exUz: Men bu qonunni prinsipial jihatdan qo'llab-quvvatlashdan bosh tortaman.

cards.ex: If you break the law, you'll have to pay the price.
cards.exUz: Agar siz qonunni buzsaiz, narxini to'lashingiz kerak bo'ladi.
cards.uzDef: Noto'g'ri xatti-harakatlar uchun oqibatlarga duch kelish.

cards.ex: His comments crossed the line and were completely inappropriate.
cards.exUz: Uning izohlari chegaradan o'tdi va butunlay nomaqbul edi.

cards.ex: Everyone should be held accountable for their actions.
cards.exUz: Har bir kishi o'z harakatlari uchun javobgar bo'lishi kerak.
